videos.caption: Driving the opening straight and first sweeping corners of the Tsukuba circuit in a road car, with the minimap, speed and gear readout on screen.

Chase camera on a white car in a long sweeping bend with trees and a clubhouse in the distance.
Apex Turismo title screen with the red emblem and the tagline The Real Driving Simulator.
Generated track map of the Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps with corner names and an elevation profile.

videos.caption: Driving a car along an endlessly generated road through rolling terrain, trees and blocky buildings, with a live minimap and speed readout.

stills.alt: Third-person view of a car on a two-lane road with double yellow centre line heading toward distant hills.
Car on a curving road climbing a grassy hill, speed and gear shown bottom left and a circular minimap bottom right.

videos.caption: Orbiting camera around a 3D point-cloud reconstruction of a lab produced from video frames.
Slow-motion replay of a synthetic cricket delivery: the tracked red ball with its yellow trajectory trail flying toward the stumps.

Virtual cricket club ground with a red-roofed clubhouse and fielders in blue.
Village scoreboard in front of a clubhouse showing total, wickets and overs, with picket fence and trees.
Close view of the stumps and painted crease lines on a dirt cricket pitch.
Top-down view of a cricket pitch with stumps at both ends on short green grass.
Thatched mud-brick huts in a village clearing surrounded by jungle trees.
River rapids running through a palm-lined gorge in sunlight.
Village well with a woman carrying a clay pot, thatched huts behind and a quest hud.
Waterfall cascading over a stone weir among palms with quest notifications at top right.
Misty river at dawn with palm trees lining the bank.
Dense sal forest floor with large tree trunks and dappled light.
Split-view WebGL relighting viewer showing the baked appearance of a 3D Gaussian splat lab instrument on the left and the relit result on the right, with the control panel at right.

Top-down simulation of a ball leaving the bat while the nearest fielders compute intercept points and run to catch it across three field settings.
